meaning:
1) to extend, stretch out
1a) (Qal) extended (participle)
1b) (Hithpael) to stretch oneself

renderings.kjv: than that a man can stretch

elsewhere.note: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
